title: Administration
valueHelp: Non-cancelled orders, grouped by currency. This is order value, not received revenue. The average is that total divided by the order count, rounded down.
topHelp: Non-cancelled orders, by the product name saved on the order. The amount is line value, not received revenue.
exportHelp: The file uses the current search and status, up to 5000 orders. Orders are not changed.
moduleHelp: Only implemented capabilities can be enabled. Optional modules remain unavailable until implemented.
customerHelp: Edit the display name. Email, passwords and roles are managed through separate account workflows. Order snapshots remain unchanged.
name: Name
paymentHelp: Fulfillment changes do not mark an order as paid.
profileHelp: A profile sets installed checkout flags. Store name, currency, catalog, and orders stay as they are.
simple_sellerHelp: Accounts, registration, and guest checkout on. Reviews, wishlist, coupons, shipping, and cash on delivery off.
standard_storeHelp: Accounts, registration, guest checkout, reviews, wishlist, coupons, and shipping on. Cash on delivery off.
catalog_onlyHelp: Accounts, registration, guest checkout, and optional modules off. Administrators can still sign in.
setupHelp: Choose a profile, then confirm the shop record. You can run this again. Catalog and existing orders stay as they are.
setupCurrencyHelp: A currency change applies to new products. Existing orders keep their currency.
